fact: The Ministry of Health's Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2022, dated July 2023 (figures cover 2022), says health statistics come from the routine health information subsystem (facility reports via zone sanitaire), complemented by subsystems including civil registration (état civil), and that maternal and infant deaths were corrected against the SIMR database.
The Ministry of Health says the 2022 yearbook of health statistics, dated July 2023, is the fifth edition since the framework document for the yearbooks was drawn up.

INStaD published its yearbook of civil-status statistics for 2024 (births, marriages, deaths for all 77 communes, e.g. 468,570 births registered, 3,228 marriages, 9,707 deaths), compiled from the civil-registration database of ANIP; the figures cover 2024 and the yearbook is dated November 2025.
